summary: The menu (as of 2026-11-24, 52 names) is led by VRSN, the only F9 at the top of its sector (gp_sector_pct 0.993, CFO $1.09B vs NI $0.83B), then CARG and DPZ at gp_sector_pct 1.0 with CFO well above earnings. Fresh FY2026 10-Ks (TTEK, UGI, WDFC) and FTDR's clean F9 fill out the middle. The main accounting concerns are DORM (CFO about half of NI), the amended-filing flags on GRMN and ONC, and stale fiscal years at CLX and BLBD. No lesson in learning.json names the Fundamentals Analyst and there are no graded calls for this role, so none shaped these calls; I used news_memory only to note pending deals (RRC, CART) that make their fundamentals rank moot.
